title: Toward a New Culture of the Material
summary: The publication takes up the vision to rediscover the analog within activities of images, spaces and materials in the age of the digital. The contributions, based on digital lectures of the Excellence Cluster »Matters of Activity«, show paradigmatically how biology and technology, mind and material intertwine in a new way. Inspired by nature, objects and materials are rethought as active and recyclable processes.
